entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 16.09.1997 and 11.08.1998.

The First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Budaun vide order dated 16.09.1997 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Budaun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 51 of 1997 and Appellate Court while dismissing appeal, confirmed order of conviction and sentence passed by Trial Court.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
